lines.17: 「Your complexion has improved lately. You seem full of life.」
lines.19: 「Yes. You and Kanisawa appear well suited to one another.」
lines.20: 「As your sister, my feelings are somewhat complicated... Perhaps being strict with you is not enough.」
lines.24: 「These contain shishito peppers and dried young sardines. Those are simmered hijiki.」
lines.28: 「Then you have something to look forward to. A boyfriend could ask for no more.」
lines.30: 「...You should find yourself a boyfriend too.」
lines.32: 「School keeps me busy, as does training. Yet insufficient sleep is unhealthy, so I must also sleep properly.」
lines.33: 「That accounts for all twenty-four hours. If only a day had thirty-six.」
lines.40: 「There is a meeting tomorrow, so the executive council will not be gathering.」
lines.41: 「Class proposals for the Ryuumei Festival are starting to come in. We'll decide which to approve and which to reject.」
lines.42: 「I could simply make all the decisions myself, of course.」
lines.43: 「Erika's sense of taste is a little warped, so we all need to decide together.」
lines.44: 「Our resident nag insists, so we'll settle everything by majority vote.」
lines.45: 「I don't nag because I enjoy it.」
lines.47: 「And you two over there--stop clinging to each other.」
lines.49: 「Come on. Let's do what she says in here.」
lines.50: 「Hmph. You're always so obedient when the Princess tells you something.」
lines.51: 「What, jealous? Don't worry. You're the only one I see anymore.」
lines.52: 「Yeah. Leo's the only one I see too.」
lines.54: Wow. She said it with a smile.
lines.55: 「First, Class 3-A: a cafe. Just an ordinary cafe.」
lines.58: 「What is it, one half of the idiot couple?」
lines.59: 「Is 'boring' really a valid reason to reject it?」
lines.60: 「I'd understand a costume cafe. But an ordinary cafe is dull.」
lines.61: 「A costume grope cafe would be ideal. Then I might even visit as a customer.」
lines.62: Now I understood why Sato wanted everyone to decide together.
lines.64: 「Hey, hey. Coconut's been staring at us ever since the vote.」
lines.66: 「Maybe she's jealous because you and I are flirting.」
lines.67: 「I was merely thinking that you were an eyesore and should disappear. Is there a problem?」
lines.68: 「Oh, you only thought it? Is that how you always live, stewing in your own gloom?」
lines.69: 「If you have something to say, nobody will understand unless you say it out loud.」
lines.70: 「Yeah. We took the long way around because of that.」
lines.71: 「Why do I feel as though this idiot couple just mocked me...? This is intolerable.」
lines.72: 「Cheer up. Something good'll happen to you someday.」
lines.74: 「Hmph! Like I'd lose to some twisted little brat.」
lines.76: Well, at least they seemed as close as ever.
